### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
* 
  
  We Committed to Quality Products
* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India. 

[Manufacturing and Export Company][Manufacturing and Export Company]

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008

to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

# Denken Sie über Zahlen hinaus!

Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Bereich, in dem die eigentliche Dynamik oft ihren Anfang nimmt: kleine
und mittelständische Innovatoren. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, die zugrunde liegenden Probleme der
Investoren aufzudecken, eine klare und umsetzbare Investorenlandkarte zu erstellen und Ihre
Geschichte auf den wichtigen Plattformen und Datenterminals zu positionieren. Durch gezielte,
marktspezifische Kontaktaufnahme in Europa, Nordamerika, APAC und LATAM stellen wir sicher, dass
Ihre Geschichte die Schreibtische erreicht, die aktiv die Kapitalströme beeinflussen.

[ Get Started ][32]
[VASRO GmbH - Invest with insight]

## Was wir tun

Wir helfen börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen dabei, die ihnen oft fehlende Sichtbarkeit
für Investoren zu erlangen. Wir identifizieren die zugrunde liegenden Lücken und teilen sie Ihnen
mit, wobei wir den Prozess auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zuschneiden. Auf dieser Grundlage erstellen wir eine
präzise Investorenübersicht, positionieren Ihre Geschichte auf führenden Plattformen und
Datenterminals und führen gezielte Kontaktaufnahmen mit den für Sie wichtigen Desks durch – und zwar
dort, wo Ihre Geschichte für sie von Bedeutung ist.

### Maximierung der Sichtbarkeit für Investoren

Finden Sie die richtigen Ansprechpartner, positionieren Sie Ihre Geschichte dort, wo Fachleute
tatsächlich arbeiten, und führen Sie gezielte Outreach-Maßnahmen mit disziplinierter Kadenz sowohl
für Privatanleger als auch für institutionelle Anleger durch.

### Analystenfertige Equity-Berichte

Branchenspezialist, unterzeichnungsfähige Thesen, die auf einem klaren Modell, definierten Risiken,
Katalysatoren und einem praktischen Umsetzungsplan basieren.

### Schließen die Einzelhandelsforschung Lücke Gap

Verwandeln Sie Ihre Eigenkapitalberichte in kurze, neutrale Updates und veröffentlichen Sie diese
nach Bedarf auf den Kanälen, die private Investoren bereits nutzen.

## Sprechen Sie die Sprache der Investoren

Klare Botschaften, die die Entdeckung stärken, sinnvolle Folgemaßnahmen fördern und eine höhere
Qualität der Eigentümerschaft unterstützen.

[image]

## Kundenorientiert

Priorisierung des Kundenerfolgs durch relevante und wirkungsvolle Erkenntnisse.

[image]

## Fokus auf Wachstumsphase und mittelständische Unternehmen

Wir stärken die Sichtbarkeit durch die Positionierung Ihrer Erzählung dort, wo Ihr Publikum sie
sucht.

[image]

## Dauerhafte Kooperationen

Aufbau dauerhafter, kooperativer und vertrauensvoller Partnerschaften.

## Wer Wir arbeiten zusammen mit

Wir arbeiten mit börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen zusammen, die eine präzisere und
gezieltere Aktienabdeckung anstreben. Unser Tätigkeitsbereich erstreckt sich über Europa,

# Denken Sie über Zahlen hinaus!

Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Bereich, in dem die eigentliche Dynamik oft ihren Anfang nimmt: kleine
und mittelständische Innovatoren. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, die zugrunde liegenden Probleme der
Investoren aufzudecken, eine klare und umsetzbare Investorenlandkarte zu erstellen und Ihre
Geschichte auf den wichtigen Plattformen und Datenterminals zu positionieren. Durch gezielte,
marktspezifische Kontaktaufnahme in Europa, Nordamerika, APAC und LATAM stellen wir sicher, dass
Ihre Geschichte die Schreibtische erreicht, die aktiv die Kapitalströme beeinflussen.

[ Get Started ][32]
[VASRO GmbH - Invest with insight]

## Was wir tun

Wir helfen börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen dabei, die ihnen oft fehlende Sichtbarkeit
für Investoren zu erlangen. Wir identifizieren die zugrunde liegenden Lücken und teilen sie Ihnen
mit, wobei wir den Prozess auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zuschneiden. Auf dieser Grundlage erstellen wir eine
präzise Investorenübersicht, positionieren Ihre Geschichte auf führenden Plattformen und
Datenterminals und führen gezielte Kontaktaufnahmen mit den für Sie wichtigen Desks durch – und zwar
dort, wo Ihre Geschichte für sie von Bedeutung ist.

### Maximierung der Sichtbarkeit für Investoren

Finden Sie die richtigen Ansprechpartner, positionieren Sie Ihre Geschichte dort, wo Fachleute
tatsächlich arbeiten, und führen Sie gezielte Outreach-Maßnahmen mit disziplinierter Kadenz sowohl
für Privatanleger als auch für institutionelle Anleger durch.

### Analystenfertige Equity-Berichte

Branchenspezialist, unterzeichnungsfähige Thesen, die auf einem klaren Modell, definierten Risiken,
Katalysatoren und einem praktischen Umsetzungsplan basieren.

### Schließen die Einzelhandelsforschung Lücke Gap

Verwandeln Sie Ihre Eigenkapitalberichte in kurze, neutrale Updates und veröffentlichen Sie diese
nach Bedarf auf den Kanälen, die private Investoren bereits nutzen.

## Sprechen Sie die Sprache der Investoren

Klare Botschaften, die die Entdeckung stärken, sinnvolle Folgemaßnahmen fördern und eine höhere
Qualität der Eigentümerschaft unterstützen.

[image]

## Kundenorientiert

Priorisierung des Kundenerfolgs durch relevante und wirkungsvolle Erkenntnisse.

[image]

## Fokus auf Wachstumsphase und mittelständische Unternehmen

Wir stärken die Sichtbarkeit durch die Positionierung Ihrer Erzählung dort, wo Ihr Publikum sie
sucht.

[image]

## Dauerhafte Kooperationen

Aufbau dauerhafter, kooperativer und vertrauensvoller Partnerschaften.

## Wer Wir arbeiten zusammen mit

Wir arbeiten mit börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen zusammen, die eine präzisere und
gezieltere Aktienabdeckung anstreben. Unser Tätigkeitsbereich erstreckt sich über Europa,
Nordamerika, den asiatisch-pazifischen Raum und ausgewählte lateinamerikanische Märkte, wodurch wir
eine global einheitliche Sichtbarkeitsstrategie anstelle fragmentierter regionaler Bemühungen
gewährleisten. Wir sind in allen wichtigen Branchen tätig und verfügen über eine besondere
Spezialisierung in Bereichen, in denen die Erwartungen der Anleger und die technischen Anforderungen
besonders hoch sind, darunter Pharma/Biotech, Technologie, Energie, Informationstechnologie und
angrenzende Industriesegmente. Diese Kombination ermöglicht es uns, die Geschichte jedes Emittenten
mit branchenrelevanter Präzision zu positionieren und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass sie die
Desks und Regionen erreicht, in denen die Kapitalbildung tatsächlich stattfindet.
* Investor-visibility diagnostics (IPI)
* Equity report packs (analyst-ready)
* Investor map & targeted placements
* Visibility upgrades and cadence

## Unsere Lösungen

[[image]][42]

### [Eigenkapital Berichte (für Analysten vorbereitet)][43]

Spezialisierte Aktienberichte, die das Betriebsmodell, das Risikoprofil, die Katalysatoren und den
weiteren Weg klar darlegen – so strukturiert, dass Buy-Side-Teams und Analysten die These schnell
bewerten, vergleichen und überdenken können.

[ Weiter lesen ][44]
[[image]][45]

### [Investor Mapping & Placement][46]

Eine strukturierte Investorenübersicht, die Zielabteilungen definiert, erklärt, warum Ihre
Geschichte zu deren Mandat passt, und die praktischen Kontaktwege und -rhythmen aufzeigt – gefolgt
von der Platzierung auf führenden Investorenplattformen und Datenterminals sowie einer direkten,
kontobezogenen Kontaktaufnahme.

[ Weiter lesen ][47]
[[image]][48]

### [Visibility Upgrades (Quarterly + As Needed)][49]

A recurring visibility layer: a quarterly baseline review, plus additional updates around key
milestones and catalysts. We refine the thesis, refresh placements, and assess the quality of
engagement and follow-through — not just impressions or vanity clicks.

[ Weiter lesen ][50]
Entdecken Sie unser umfassendes Angebot an Dienstleistungen, die auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten
sind.
[ See all of the Services ][51]

## Branchen, die wir abdecken

Wir decken **alle öffentlichen Marktsektoren** ab, wobei wir uns stärker auf Bereiche
spezialisieren, in denen technische und regulatorische Komplexität eine präzisere Anlegerausrichtung
erfordern.

Pharma & Biotechnologie

Klinische und marktbezogene Realitäten, die in versicherbare Thesen mit klarem Risiko- und
Zeitrahmenkontext umgesetzt wurden.

Technologie

Infrastruktur, Plattformen, und Software positioniert mit dauerhaften Treibern und Kategorie
Relevanz.

Energie

Cashflow Form, Projekt Kadenz, und Richtlinien Hebel destilliert für institutionelle Workflows.

Industrieunternehmen (angrenzend)

Operative Leistung, Dynamik der Lieferkette und Ausführungsqualität, die so gestaltet sind, dass sie
die Widerstandsfähigkeit und die mittelfristige Wertschöpfung hervorheben.

[ [VASRO GmbH] ][52]
Die VASRO GmbH ist spezialisiert auf Aktienanalysen, Marktbeobachtung und Anlagestrategien in den
Bereichen Pharma, Biotechnologie und IT. Wir liefern maßgeschneiderte Erkenntnisse, um fundierte
Anlageentscheidungen zu treffen und außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

## Viant Company FAQs

### What does Viant do as a medical device contract manufacturing company?

Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer providing end-to-end contract manufacturing for
medical devices—from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile
device assembly. OEMs and MedTech startups partner with Viant as a single-source manufacturer of
medical devices or engage specific capabilities as needed.

### What makes Viant different from other medical device contract manufacturers?

A vertically integrated model with global manufacturing facilities is what differentiates Viant from
many medical device contract manufacturers. With ViaLaunch™ program management, engineering support,
and quality management systems across its footprint, device manufacturers can move from development
into production with stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.

### What capabilities does Viant offer for contract manufacturing for medical devices?

A broad set of contract manufacturing services across the device lifecycle: program management,
medical device engineering support, materials expertise, metals (including metal tubing),
extrusions, medical‑grade plastics (including micro‑molding), tooling, automation capabilities,
device assembly, and finished device services. Viant combines these capabilities within a vertically
integrated manufacturing network.

### What clinical markets does Viant support?

Viant supports a range of clinical device applications, including Orthopedics, Surgical
Technologies, Cardiac & Interventional, Drug Delivery, Bioprocessing, Bioelectronics, Diagnostics &
Laboratory Products, and Respiratory, Monitoring & Patient Care.

### How large is Viant’s manufacturing footprint?

A global manufacturing footprint of 26 locations, 2.3M square feet of manufacturing space, and 300K+
square feet of cleanroom space. With Viant, device manufacturers can leverage regional production
options and scalable capacity across programs.

## Viant Company FAQs

### What does Viant do as a medical device contract manufacturing company?

Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer providing end-to-end contract manufacturing for
medical devices—from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile
device assembly. OEMs and MedTech startups partner with Viant as a single-source manufacturer of
medical devices or engage specific capabilities as needed.

### What makes Viant different from other medical device contract manufacturers?

A vertically integrated model with global manufacturing facilities is what differentiates Viant from
many medical device contract manufacturers. With ViaLaunch™ program management, engineering support,
and quality management systems across its footprint, device manufacturers can move from development
into production with stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.

### What capabilities does Viant offer for contract manufacturing for medical devices?

A broad set of contract manufacturing services across the device lifecycle: program management,
medical device engineering support, materials expertise, metals (including metal tubing),
extrusions, medical‑grade plastics (including micro‑molding), tooling, automation capabilities,
device assembly, and finished device services. Viant combines these capabilities within a vertically
integrated manufacturing network.

### What clinical markets does Viant support?

Viant supports a range of clinical device applications, including Orthopedics, Surgical
Technologies, Cardiac & Interventional, Drug Delivery, Bioprocessing, Bioelectronics, Diagnostics &
Laboratory Products, and Respiratory, Monitoring & Patient Care.

### How large is Viant’s manufacturing footprint?

A global manufacturing footprint of 26 locations, 2.3M square feet of manufacturing space, and 300K+
square feet of cleanroom space. With Viant, device manufacturers can leverage regional production
options and scalable capacity across programs.

# Drug and Biologic Delivery Systems

### Delivery device technology with a “patient-centric” focus.

We provide patient-centric delivery device technology and primary container packaging for
pharmaceutical, biotech and personal care companies worldwide. We combine novel technology and
technical services to provide solutions to challenging drug, biopharmaceutical, biologic or
botanical delivery applications tailored to meet your technical specifications and market
requirements. We utilize a technology platform approach in combination with technical services to
provide custom configured packaging and delivery systems for liquid, powder and reconstituted powder
formulations. Delivery systems for ophthalmic, systemic intranasal, nose to brain, sublingual,
buccal, and otic, routes of administration are available.

## [Routes of Drug Delivery][22]

We offer delivery device configurations for the following routes of administration

[][23]

[][24]

### Intranasal

[][25]

### Nose to  Brain

[][26]

### Sublingual

[][27]

### Animal Care

## Analytical Services

Services include:
* Dispense Characterization via laser diffraction
* Dispense Plume Morphology via high speed video
* Aerodynamic Deposition (in-vitro upper and lower respiratory tracks)
* Delivered Dose Uniformity and Consistency
* Emitted Dose (shot weight/mass transfer)
* Size Exclusion Chromatography

## Pre-Commercial Services

Services include:
* combination product primary container/dispenser configuration and optimization
* prototype configuration and supply
* analytical testing (devices, primary containers, dispense characteristics)
* process engineering (fill process manufacturing)
* pre-clinical and clinical supply
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation

## Commercial Services

Services include:
* commercial technology transfer
* commercial scale up
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation
* commercial supply
* capital equipment supply and siting
* technology licensing 

[Learn More][28]
[Learn More][29]
[Learn More][30]

## Technology Platforms

Our ZTECH-L™ Delivery Platform is designed to package and deliver liquid drugs, biopharmaceuticals,
biologics and botanicals, while the ZTECH-P™ Delivery Platform is designed for powders or
reconstituted powder to liquid drug/device combination product applications.

[Technology Platforms][31]
[Devices][32]
[Primary Containers][33]

## Biosecurity

Zeteo Biomedical’s ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ drug and biologic delivery platforms provide solutions to
package and administer vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures for infectious diseases
and bio-terror threats.  ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ nasal and sublingual delivery devices are readily
adaptable to public health needs, including rapid manufacturing and deployment to support both self
or caregiver administration options for vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures across
large populations under crisis conditions.

[Learn More][34]

## **Applied Innovation**

Zeteo’s novel drug delivery systems require no priming. We provide consistent, precise dosing and
efficient unit dose packaging to reduce the cost per dose. Devices are available in mono-dose and
multi-dose configurations. The dose counter keeps track of administration, reducing dosing errors
and increasing adherence. The devices are compact, easily carried in a purse or pocket and, with a
small learning curve, enable patient simple self-administration. Our commercially scalable Form Fill
Seal packaging technology supports both non-sterile and aseptic fill processes.

[Learn more][35]

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

for small-batch manufacturing.

Every project is unique, and we tailor our engineering and design approach to meet specific
technical and commercial requirements. Our manufacturing facilities are flexible and built to scale
with our customers as they grow into high-volume production.

#### Global Manufacturing Capacity

Scaling production requires the right facilities, expertise, and global reach. As part of the Sanner
Group, Gilero operates more than 300,000 square feet of manufacturing space and ISO Class 7 and 8
